title: A broadcasting bug in a loss
summary: Spot why a regression loss trains badly while running without errors.

choices.text: `**` on a tensor is elementwise, so the squared error is fine; the learning rate must be too high.
`mean()` over a `(N, 1)` tensor averages only the first column, so half the targets are ignored.
The subtraction raises a shape error only on the GPU, and the CPU silently drops the extra axis.
`pred - y` broadcasts to `(N, N)`, so the loss compares every prediction with every target.
